Hi Maya — thanks for the details and the ticket number. Quick summary of our standard flow (attached runbook):

1) Scope confirmation: customer provides list of tenant identifiers / user IDs / dataset names. We verify match to production artifacts.
2) Hold window: we schedule a 48-hour maintenance window for irreversible deletions to allow any last-minute rollback requests.
3) Execution: ops runs a coordinated wipe that removes prompt-output artifacts, KV cache entries, and active logs. For backups/snapshots: we will remove any application-level backups created by Redwood; infrastructure-level cold snapshots (cloud provider-managed) require a provider-side workflow — we can coordinate with your infra team or raise a marketplace removal task.
4) Evidence: we provide a manifest of files deleted (csv), KMS log entries (key-zeroization timestamps), and a signed completion certificate (PDF).

I've attached our decom_runbook_v1.pdf for reference and included a proposed consent DocuSign for you to sign to authorize the operation: https://docusign.net/FIN-0042-deletion-consent.

Please send the tenant IDs and confirm whether you want us to include provider snapshot coordination. Once we have scope, Connor (ops) will propose a date.

Regards,
